reference_sql:
WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event with a user_pseudo_id from 1 to 30 November 2025
  SELECT device.category AS device_category, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
), view_time AS (
  -- one row per session (user_pseudo_id and ga_session_id) with page views from 1 to 30 November 2025
  SELECT user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
    SUM(list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'engagement_time_msec')[1].value.int_value) AS engagement_msec
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT s.device_category, COUNT(*) AS sessions,
  SUM(COALESCE(v.engagement_msec, 0)) / 1000.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_engagement_sec
FROM starts AS s
LEFT JOIN view_time AS v
  ON v.user_pseudo_id = s.user_pseudo_id AND v.ga_session_id = s.ga_session_id
WHERE s.ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.device_category
alternatives:
WITH session_events AS (
  -- one row per session_start or page_view event with both IDs from 1 to 30 November 2025
  SELECT event_name, device.category AS device_category, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'engagement_time_msec')[1].value.int_value AS engagement_msec
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name IN ('session_start', 'page_view')
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value IS NOT NULL
), sessions AS (
  -- one row per session (user_pseudo_id and ga_session_id)
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_name = 'session_start' THEN device_category END) AS device_category,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_name = 'session_start' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS started,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN event_name = 'page_view' THEN engagement_msec END), 0) AS engagement_msec
  FROM session_events
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id
)
SELECT device_category, COUNT(*) AS sessions, AVG(engagement_msec) / 1000.0 AS avg_engagement_sec
FROM sessions
WHERE started = 1
GROUP BY device_category

WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event with both IDs from 1 to 30 November 2025
  SELECT device.category AS device_category, user_pseudo_id,
    [p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'ga_session_id'][1] AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND [p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'ga_session_id'][1] IS NOT NULL
), views AS (
  -- one row per page_view from 1 to 30 November 2025
  SELECT user_pseudo_id,
    [p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'ga_session_id'][1] AS ga_session_id,
    [p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'engagement_time_msec'][1] AS engagement_msec
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
), per_session AS (
  -- one row per session that started in the period
  SELECT s.device_category, s.user_pseudo_id, s.ga_session_id, COALESCE(SUM(v.engagement_msec), 0) AS engagement_msec
  FROM starts AS s
  LEFT JOIN views AS v
    ON v.user_pseudo_id = s.user_pseudo_id AND v.ga_session_id = s.ga_session_id
  GROUP BY s.device_category, s.user_pseudo_id, s.ga_session_id
)
SELECT device_category, COUNT(*) AS sessions, AVG(engagement_msec) / 1000.0 AS avg_engagement_sec
FROM per_session
GROUP BY device_category

solver.query:
WITH ss AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date, user_pseudo_id, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS sid, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'page_location')[1].value.string_value AS page_location, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS engaged, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_number')[1].value.int_value AS snum,
    traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, device.category AS device_category
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value IS NOT NULL
),
pv AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS sid, SUM(list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'engagement_time_msec')[1].value.int_value) AS ms FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ss.device_category, COUNT(*) AS sessions, SUM(COALESCE(pv.ms, 0)) / 1000.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_engagement_sec
FROM ss LEFT JOIN pv ON ss.user_pseudo_id = pv.user_pseudo_id AND ss.sid = pv.sid
GROUP BY ss.device_category
